summary: The recipe/title names fate23 Water Demon, but the saved C result and the first stop identify fate29 Scare. At zero-based step 12, C says the water gives the hero bad breath, then its case29 branch calls monflee() for each living monster and reaches drinkfountain()’s common dryup() tail. The current JavaScript case29 throws before the scare loop and tail. The actionable source unit is the whole fountain.c:drinkfountain() function, wired from potion.c:dodrink().

source.branch: In drinkfountain(), after rnd(30) selects fate 29 outside the blessed-fountain early-return path, print the bad-breath message, walk the live monster list in source order and call monflee(mtmp, 0, FALSE, FALSE), then return from the switch to the common dryup() tail. Fate 23 is a separate Water Demon case and is not the branch shown by this recording. The source unit is the whole drinkfountain() function; its JavaScript implementation also still refuses fates 24, 25, and 28.
callers: potion.c:dodrink() (lines 542-547) calls drinkfountain() after the hero accepts the fountain prompt.
js/potion.js:dodrink() (lines 2148-2158) calls js/fountain.js:drinkfountain() on the same accepted prompt path.
dependencies: monmove.c:monflee() (lines 461-530) is the direct fate29 effect; it can release a monster holding the hero, update fleeing state and tracking, and for a vrock can consume rn2() and create a gas cloud.
monmove.c:release_hero() and mhitu.c:expels()/unstuck() are reached by monflee() when the affected monster is u.ustuck.

fountain.c:dryup() (lines 201-239) is the common drinkfountain() tail. When a town fountain dries, dryup() calls mon.c:get_iter_mons() to find a watchman; the current JS tail calls the same imported helper under that condition.

The C scare branch walks fmon/nmon directly. JavaScript needs a mutation-safe full monster traversal for that loop; mon.js:iter_mons_async() is the asynchronous counterpart of mon.c:iter_mons(), while get_iter_mons() returns only the first accepted monster.

A83 actual reservation relevant to the common tail: source:mon.c:get_iter_mons. A83 also reserves contract:mon-removal-conditional-completion and mon.c:m_detach, m_in_air, mnearto, mon_leaving_level, mondead, mongone, relmon, replmon, and xkilled, plus monmove.c:accessible, closed_door, and onscary; those are not direct owners of the fate29 source branch. A83 has no source:fountain.c:drinkfountain or source:monmove.c:monflee reservation. js/fountain.js and js/monmove.js appear in allowedPaths, which is separate from function reservations.
